description: This PHP source file defines a REST API endpoint class 'ThemeAPI' for managing theme configurations in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, and resetting theme data, with validation rules and handling of theme-related assets such as logos and banners.

classes.name: ThemeAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing theme configurations such as variables, logos, and banners within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the current theme data, returning a partial theme model.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates theme variables and assets based on the provided request data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Resets the theme to its default state by deleting the custom theme.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getOne' request, excluding the ID parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating the theme, including validation of attachments and variables.

methods.name: getAttachmentParamRule
methods.description: Creates validation rules for attachment parameters, including aspect ratio constraints.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete request, excluding ID parameter.
